guides.intro: What a Feral druid presses from level 1 to 60, stage by stage, as the trainer and the talent tree hand you new buttons. The cat is the druid's fastest leveling build in the fight lab: Wrath and Moonfire to 9, Bear Form from 10 to 19, and from 20 a cat that prowls up behind the mob, claws, bleeds it and bites. The page build (11/29/11) is a Feral Combat build with eleven points in Balance for crit, hit and bleed damage and eleven in Restoration for Heart of the Wild and Naturalist. Each stage lists the full priority, so you can jump in at your level.

stages.title: Wrath, then your weapon
stages.change: **Wrath** as the mob comes, melee once it is on you.
press: **Wrath** as the mob comes at you, and again as long as your mana lasts.
Melee once it reaches you: an early Wrath is slow, and the mob's hits push the cast back.
stages.if_hurt: **Healing Touch** below a third of your health. The mob hits you through the cast, so step back first when you can.
notes: The fight lab does not model levels 1-9 (it only swings the weapon there), so this stage and the next carry no numbers.
**Mark of the Wild** (1) is a buff: keep it on, no key.

stages.title: Moonfire
stages.change: **Moonfire** once at the pull, **Wrath** while the mob walks in, melee after.
press: **Moonfire** once as the mob comes: the hit and the bleed.
**Wrath** while it walks in.
Melee once it reaches you. **Wrath** between hits only while you have the mana: at these levels your water is the limit.
stages.if_hurt: **Rejuvenation** on yourself at the first hits, **Healing Touch** below a third of your health.
notes: **Thorns** (6) is a buff: keep it on, no key.
**Entangling Roots** (8): root the mob, step back, cast. Damage can break it.
Levels 1-9 are not in the fight lab: no numbers.

stages.title: Bear Form
stages.change: **Bear Form**: walk up, **Demoralizing Roar** once, **Maul** on every swing you have the rage for.
press: **Bear Form** before the pull and stay in it. Walk up to the mob: a bear has no stealth.
**Demoralizing Roar** once the mob is on you.
**Maul** whenever you have the rage: it replaces your next swing. White swings fill the rest.
stages.if_hurt: Below 30% of your health while the mob has more than a quarter of its own: leave **Bear Form**, **Healing Touch** or **Rejuvenation**, then **Bear Form** again. At these levels the mob usually dies first.
notes: From 12, **Enrage** at the pull: 10 rage now and 20 more over 10 s, for 27% of your armor. The fight lab presses it on a mob above 40% of its health.
**Regrowth** (12) is your fight heal from here: a big heal plus a heal over time.
**Nature's Grasp** (10) can be cast in a form: the next mob that hits you is rooted. Walk away and heal.
**Growl** (10) is a taunt: for groups.

stages.title: Bash
stages.change: **Enrage** at the pull, **Bash** a mob that casts.
press: **Enrage** at the pull while the mob has more than 40% of its health.
**Demoralizing Roar** once the mob is on you.
**Bash** a mob that starts casting, or whenever you drop below 40% of your health.
**Maul** whenever you have the rage. White swings fill the rest.
stages.if_hurt: **Bash** buys you 2 seconds. Below 30% of your health: leave **Bear Form**, **Regrowth**, then **Bear Form** again.
notes: **Swipe** (16) hits three mobs for little: for pulls of two or three, never one.
**Hibernate** (18) sleeps a second beast or dragonkin for up to 20 s: cast it from caster form before the pull.
**Faerie Fire** (18) is not worth the shift out; the fight lab never casts it.
**Cat Form** comes at 20 and changes everything.

stages.title: Cat Form
stages.change: **Cat Form**: **Prowl** up behind the mob, **Claw** to 2 points, **Rip**.
press: **Cat Form** before the pull. **Prowl**, and walk up behind the mob.
**Claw** to 2 combo points.
**Rip** at 2 points while the mob has more than 40% of its health: the bleed finishes it while you claw.
**Claw** until it is dead.
stages.if_hurt: Below 30% of your health while the mob has more than a quarter of its own: leave **Cat Form**, **Regrowth**, then **Cat Form** again. Keep the mana for that: Cat Form costs 55% of your base mana each time.
notes: **Shred** (20) needs the mob's back. A mob facing you cannot be Shredded, and the tuned rules never cast it.
**Omen of Clarity** (20) is a buff: keep it on, no key. It makes an ability free now and then.
Energy, not mana, limits you now. **Furor** (24 in this order) gives you part of your energy back when you shift back in.

stages.title: Ferocious Bite and Rake
stages.change: **Rake** once, **Claw** to build, **Ferocious Bite** as soon as it kills.
press: **Prowl** up behind the mob; **Claw** is the first hit.
**Rake** once while the mob has more than 30% of its health: it bleeds for 9 s.
**Claw** to build combo points.
**Ferocious Bite** at any number of points as soon as it will kill the mob.
stages.if_hurt: Below 30% of your health while the mob has more than a quarter of its own: leave **Cat Form**, **Regrowth**, then **Cat Form** again.
notes: **Rip** stays for a mob above half its health at 5 points. One on one, Claw and Bite get there first: the fight lab casts it about once in ten fights from 52 and never here.
**Dash** (26): 50% faster for 15 s in Cat Form, prowling or not. The escape, and the way to the next mob.
**Travel Form** (30) is the road between mobs.
**Cower** (28) drops your threat and **Challenging Roar** (28) is a bear taunt: groups only.

stages.title: Ravage
stages.change: **Ravage** from **Prowl**: the opener that takes a third of the mob.
press: **Prowl** up behind the mob and open with **Ravage**: 435% weapon damage from stealth, the biggest hit you have.
**Rake** while the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Claw** to build combo points.
**Ferocious Bite** as soon as it will kill the mob.
stages.if_hurt: Below 30% of your health while the mob has more than a quarter of its own: leave **Cat Form**, **Regrowth**, then **Cat Form** again.
notes: **Poised** (32): rested to full energy out of combat, your next ability costs 10 less. Wait for full energy before you prowl in, and Ravage costs 50 instead of 60.

**Pounce** (36) is the other stealth opener: a 2 s stun and a bleed for 1 combo point. With full energy the fight lab always has the 60 for Ravage, which hits harder; Pounce is for a caster you want quiet for the first seconds.
**Frenzied Regeneration** (36) turns rage into health in Bear Form.
**Track Humanoids** (32) is a tracking: clicked, no key.

stages.title: The same play to 60
stages.change: Nothing new to press. **Dire Bear Form** arrives; the deep Feral talents (**Primal Bite**, **Shifting Power**) are not in this build.
press: **Prowl** up behind the mob and open with **Ravage**.
**Rake** while the mob has more than 30% of its health.
**Claw** to build combo points.
**Ferocious Bite** as soon as it will kill the mob.
stages.if_hurt: Below 30% of your health while the mob has more than a quarter of its own: leave **Cat Form**, **Regrowth**, then **Cat Form** again.
notes: **Dire Bear Form** (40) is Bear Form with more armor and attack power: for dungeons.
**Primal Bite** and **Shifting Power** are the Feral tree's last row: this build stops at Rend and Tear and never has them.
From 54, **Feral Charge** (the talent): at a caster that stands and casts at 8-25 yards, you leap behind it and interrupt it for 4 s. The fight lab meets few casters at range, so it rarely fires.
**Barkskin** (44) needs caster form: 20% less physical damage for 15 s, before a hard pull.
**Innervate** (40): mana for a group's healer, or for you after a run of heals.

between: Below 70% of your health after a fight: leave Cat Form, **Rejuvenation** (and **Regrowth** if you are still below 85%), then Cat Form again, only with the mana to shift back.
Drink when your mana is below about a third (35%): mana only pays for shifts and heals. Eat below two thirds of your health when there was no mana to heal.
Visit the trainer every even level: **Claw**, **Rake**, **Rip**, **Ferocious Bite** and **Ravage** all have many ranks.
other: Balance (36/0/15, the Moonkin) is 63% slower per kill in the fight lab (37.4 against 22.9 s) and has its own page in this folder with the Moonkin rotation.
Restoration levels as a cat with its raid build (11/4/36): 28.5 s per kill, a quarter slower than Feral Combat.

keys.intro: Your two action bars, slot by slot: bar 1 is Q, E, R, F, Mouse 5, Mouse 4, 1, 2, 3, 4, C and the middle mouse button; bar 2 is the same keys with Shift, and Shift+X in the last slot. A druid's bar 1 is three bars in one: WoW shows the form's own bar while you are in Bear Form or Cat Form, and the Prowl bar while you prowl, so the tables below give bar 1 once per form. Keys are for spells you press in a fight and for the things that help you there; Mark of the Wild, Thorns, Omen of Clarity, the tracking, food, water, the mount and the Hearthstone have no key, you click them between fights. The scheme is the same on every class and in every form: Q the attack you press most, E the control, R the payoff, F the escape, the thumb buttons the reactions, 1-4 the rest, the Shift bar the forms and the rarer tools. A key keeps its job from 1 to 60. Bold marks what arrives in that stage. Free slots stay free until something earns them. Setup: the [druid keybinds page](keybinds.md).

bars.title: Action bar 1 out of form (levels 1-9, and whenever you shift out)

slots.role: Control: root it and step back
The save before a hard pull
The fight heal you shift out for
The heal over time: in a fight at 1-9, between fights later
Mana for a healer, or for you

bars.title: Action bar 1 in Bear Form (levels 10-19; WoW swaps the bar when you shift)

slots.role: Your attack: it replaces the next swing; the macro also starts your swings
Taunt: a mob on a friend
Your attack: the combo points; the macro also starts your swings
Control: leap behind a caster and interrupt it
The bleed finisher: every fight at 20-23, rare after

bars.title: Action bar 1 while prowling: copy the Cat Form bar, then change Q and E

slots.role: The opener from behind (before 32: Claw, the copied key)

bars.title: Action bar 2: the same keys with Shift, in every form

slots.role: Cat Form; press it again to leave
Bear Form; press it again to leave
The escape in any form: the next mob that hits you is rooted

notes: Bar 1 is three bars in one: WoW shows the form's own bar while you are in Bear Form or Cat Form, and the Prowl bar while you prowl (as Classic did). Set each one up so a key keeps its job in every form: Q attacks, E controls, R pays off, F saves.
The forms live on the Shift bar, the same in every form: Shift+Q Cat Form, Shift+E Bear Form, Shift+R Travel Form. Pressing your current form's key leaves it.
The emergency heal is three presses: Shift+Q (leave Cat Form), Mouse 5 (Regrowth, on the bar you now see), Shift+Q (Cat Form again). The keybinds page has a macro that makes it two.
No key: **Mark of the Wild**, **Thorns**, **Omen of Clarity**, **Track Humanoids**, food, water, the mount and the Hearthstone.

Levels 1-9 fight with Q and R on the caster bar: right-click the mob to start swinging. From 10, Q on each form's bar is a macro on the [keybinds page](keybinds.md) that also starts your swings, so the middle mouse button stays free.
